instruction: Show the results from the 2018 Super Bowl.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the 2018 Super Bowl scores page (post4 is Super Bowl week). Uses existing evaluator functions to verify the active tab URL matches https://www.nfl.com/scores/2018/post4. Very similar to original task structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct for verifying the instruction
Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly compares the extracted URL against expected URL using compare_urls function
Expected URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2018/post4' is semantically correct for 2018 Super Bowl (post4 = Super Bowl week)
Data flow is correct: String URL from getter -> Metric receives and compares -> Returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
Complete coverage: Evaluator fully verifies that user navigated to the 2018 Super Bowl scores page
No edge case issues: URL comparison is robust and handles variations correctly
